response.what_it_is: Multiple used electronic keyboards stacked and wrapped in protective plastic film
hidden_risks: whether all keys and buttons are fully functional
presence of internal dust or moisture damage
availability of power adapters or music rests
response.best_proof: A clear, close-up photograph of an individual keyboard's control panel and powered-on display screen
response.failure_mode: Mistaking the multiple keyboards shown in the bulk stack for a single item, or incorrectly assuming the asking price applies to the entire lot rather than per piece.
